report:
Reviewed the complete detail_free_index claim, three ordinary implementation associations, and its single explicit TODO test. Requirements are: one eager complete local directory for search; browser-only filtering without transmitting search text or fetching branches; exclusion of dependency symbols; allowance of external facts needed for macro expansion but no broader semantic metadata or item details.

Source inspection: LiveInspectionProvider::symbols builds one SymbolDirectory, returns its SymbolIndex, and caches the directory. indexed_symbols emits the root then recursively walks represented ownership children. canonical_children filters external symbols before rendering. owned_symbol_children enumerates local modules, enum variants and direct trait/impl members; it does not resolve dependency trees. Summaries contain identity, search text, presentation and child completeness, while selected_symbol/product functions are separate demand paths. local_symbol_presentation uses source spans and kind labels rather than checked signatures or bodies. The associated.rs membership helpers enumerate CST identities and construct tracked associated symbols without lowering signatures or bodies. The newly associated mods.rs expansion/completeness implementation walks parsed and macro-expanded members, uses macro resolution and builtin-derive metadata, and marks unavailable expansion explicitly incomplete. Thus directory completeness describes eager enumeration of represented children, with unsupported expansion honestly visible rather than lazy branch fetching. Source inspection found no eager semantic product call on these directory entry paths. The closed transitive operation envelope still requires the deferred trace test; this report does not claim that placeholder establishes it.

Browser dependencies were captured with review read. InspectorApp bootstraps api.symbols once per revision/reset, builds child maps from index.symbols, and filters the same symbols using trimmed lowercase search_text. Branch toggling changes an in-memory Set. Search updates the q view parameter; the selection effect depends on memoized pathname intent rather than search text. ApiClient.symbols has a fixed endpoint without search parameters. The captured existing browser tests concern generic rendering and links and do not exercise this directory behavior; they are not claimed as coverage. These TypeScript files remain explicit captured dependencies because the Rust association inventory cannot attach their implementations.

Test adequacy: the sole test sage_meta::todo::crates_sage_inspector_inspection_detail_free_index is an empty intentional deferred test, not behavioral evidence. Its refined explanation now accounts for every requirement and names the prerequisites: source-backed integration fixtures containing nested ownership, macros and dependencies, plus browser request recording. Required future assertions cover complete local membership, dependency/detail exclusion, the permitted macro metadata operation envelope and forbidden signature/body/associated-value/impl-discovery work, correct browser matches and absence of search/branch requests. This is an accepted explicit test deferral, not implemented or passing behavioral coverage. No ordinary test was reclassified. Added associations ensure the two essential Rust helper files are fresh review inputs.

Commands executed: review start/read and cargo fmt. A cargo build was launched separately and its completion is reported to the coordinator; no behavioral tests were run for this comment/association-only change. Source judgments and the explicit deferred test coverage remain distinct. Central post-codegen and Sage sanity review are coordinated by the parent agent.
